items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: You want me to explain that, Bush?

ctx.x: They never meant that fish fry. Yeah. See, Dick don't think. Dick always go on something different. Well, they want to know all that.

Yeah, Dick. You want me to explain that, Bush? Yeah, I'll tell you. Well, fish fry was nothing but, you know New Orleans, all right. Dick, you're a long way. You know where Jim live at. St. Philip Street, you know where I live at. I'm going to give a fish fry on a Saturday night. You see what you do? You get a wagon lantern light, you know. Put it on your gate with a stick, hold it out like that. And just buy fish, and you tell the people in the neighborhood, that's very few people got our tickets, like when…
As you were talking about just close to Walk with Dee, that number would never play out. I don't believe it would, because a lot of people likes it.
